page.overview:
Who is Minifigure Language?

The Minifigure Language, also known as Stud Standard, consists of 26 written letters in correspondence with the English alphabet. This language was formerly used in video games, although it has been phased out in the newer Warner Bros video games.

The letters are formed by bricks with an accorded amount of studs, and texts are written from left to right (although there have been examples of up to down writing). No way of pronunciation is known.
